scenarios.title: An indestructible creature is not destroyed by lethal damage
decisions: A casts Shock targeting Grizzly Bears, tapping Mountain, and passes priority.
B casts Sheltering Light targeting Grizzly Bears, tapping Plains.
Both players pass priority; Sheltering Light resolves and B leaves the scry card on top.
Both players pass priority; Shock resolves.

variants.label: indestructible_in_response
variants.expected: Shock deals 2 damage to Grizzly Bears (2/2), which stays on the battlefield with 2 damage marked, because the state-based action for lethal damage ignores it.

variants.label: no_response
variants.delta: B passes without casting Sheltering Light.
variants.expected: Shock deals 2 damage to Grizzly Bears, which dies in the state-based check and moves to B's graveyard.

variants.label: other_creature_protected
variants.delta: Sheltering Light targets Hill Giant instead of Grizzly Bears.
variants.expected: Grizzly Bears takes 2 damage and dies; Hill Giant gains indestructible and stays untouched.

scenarios.title: An indestructible permanent is not destroyed by a destroy effect
decisions: A casts Doom Blade targeting Grizzly Bears, tapping both Swamps, and passes priority.
B casts Sheltering Light targeting Grizzly Bears, tapping Plains.
Both players pass priority; Sheltering Light resolves and B leaves the scry card on top.
Both players pass priority; Doom Blade resolves.

variants.label: indestructible_in_response
variants.expected: Doom Blade resolves (it is not countered and does not fizzle) but Grizzly Bears is not destroyed and stays on the battlefield.

variants.label: no_response
variants.delta: B passes without casting Sheltering Light.
variants.expected: Doom Blade resolves and Grizzly Bears is destroyed and moves to B's graveyard.

scenarios.title: A creature with printed indestructible survives lethal damage and destroy effects
decisions: A casts Shock targeting Darksteel Myr, tapping Mountain, and passes priority.
Both players pass priority; Shock resolves.

variants.label: shock_indestructible
variants.expected: Shock deals 2 damage to Darksteel Myr, which stays on the battlefield with 2 damage marked.

variants.label: shock_ordinary
variants.delta: Shock targets Myr Servitor (1/1) instead of Darksteel Myr.
variants.expected: Shock deals 2 damage to Myr Servitor, which dies and moves to B's graveyard.

variants.label: doom_blade_indestructible
variants.delta: A casts Doom Blade, tapping both Swamps, instead of Shock.
variants.expected: Doom Blade resolves and Darksteel Myr stays on the battlefield.
